description: The public R3 roadmap: what is planned, in progress, proposed by the community and shipped, with each item's vote count and whether the user has voted for it — plus the user's OWN suggestions still awaiting R3's approval, marked pending, and the ones R3 declined, marked declined with R3's reason (only the user sees them; neither is votable). Do not suggest a declined item again. Read it BEFORE suggesting something (r3_roadmap_suggest): when an item already covers it, upvote that (r3_roadmap_upvote) instead of suggesting a duplicate. Narrow it with `search` (title and description, any case) and `status`.

search.description: Words to find in the title or description, any case.

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.
